notes.title: Completion of an Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. We have completed work on the following two updates.

(1) Settings for the height of the player's eye level
We have made adjustments to the player's eye level settings as we received reports of cases where the eye level was not set properly and items were difficult to pick up.

(2) Controller compatibility of "VALVE INDEX" and "VIVE Cosmos"
"VALVE INDEX" and "VIVE Cosmos" controllers can now be used to operate the app.

Thank you for your continued support for "Teasing Master Takagi-san VR - 1st Semester"!
